_note: Curated, attributive context shown beside measured results. Never a source of numbers for the change engine. Each item was checked against its source on 12 Nov 2026; see reports/P4.md.

what_happened.text: Construction began in June 2001, according to The National.
NASA Earth Observatory describes the Palm as begun in 2001 and completed in 2006, built from dredged sand.
The National reports that residential buildings began in 2006, with residents arriving a year later.

downsides.text: Environmentalists said dredging silt muddied the water and destroyed the only known coral reef off Dubai.
downsides.disputed_note: Disputed by developer: Nakheel said most of the coral was already dead.

downsides.text: Divers were reported as saying reefs, oyster beds and seagrass were being buried and choked by sediment.
downsides.disputed_note: Disputed by developer: a Nakheel scientist's rebuttal on the same page says the new reef is thriving.

downsides.text: Beaches were reported to be eroding as natural currents were disrupted.
UN University scientists warned that reduced wave action in the lagoon can promote algal blooms, and that sites where organic matter settles can lose oxygen and cause fish kills.
Lagoon currents, water budget and residence time have been studied in peer-reviewed work.
downsides.source_title: Cavalcante et al. 2011, J. Coastal Research

downsides.text: Water quality and surface temperature around the island over 2001 to 2020 were assessed with satellite data.

counterpoints.text: Developer statement: a Nakheel environmental scientist wrote that the Palm's crescent represents about 40 hectares of rocky reef.
Scientist statement: UN University scientists, in a study commissioned by Nakheel, said a new complex marine ecosystem was forming, although the waters "will never again be what they once were".

what_happened.text: The Palisades and Eaton fires both started on 7 January 2025, during a Santa Ana wind storm with gusts near 100 mph that grounded firefighting aircraft.
The Palisades fire destroyed 6,837 structures in and around Pacific Palisades.
Together the two fires burned 37,469 acres (about 152 km2) and killed 29 people; CAL FIRE reported both at 100% containment by 31 January.
The Palisades and Eaton fires both started on 7 January 2025, during a Santa Ana wind storm with gusts near 100 mph that grounded firefighting aircraft.
The Eaton fire destroyed 9,418 buildings, mostly in Altadena; 17 of the 29 deaths were found in the Eaton fire zone.
Together the two fires burned 37,469 acres (about 152 km2) and killed 29 people; CAL FIRE reported both at 100% containment by 31 January.
